user_journeys.description: General website navigation and content discovery

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: Discovered Workflow: navigation_flow - Verify Homepage Accessibility
proposed_scenarios.description: This is a critical smoke test to verify that the website's homepage is accessible. Since no interactive elements were captured during exploration, this scenario validates the most fundamental prerequisite for any user interaction: the site must load correctly. This is the only testable scenario based on the provided data.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify that the primary entry point of the e-commerce site is online, loads without errors, and is accessible to users.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a potential customer, I want to successfully navigate to the homepage so that I can begin browsing the store's products.

detailed_steps.description: Load the main website homepage at https://atid.store/ and verify the page loads successfully.
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page URL is 'https://atid.store/' and the page title is as expected for the homepage.
detailed_steps.business_impact: If the homepage fails to load, the business is completely inaccessible to all online customers, resulting in 100% loss of potential sales and severe brand damage.

expected_results: User successfully navigates to the homepage.
The browser does not return any critical errors (e.g., 404 Not Found, 500 Server Error).
The test confirms the site is online and reachable.
edge_cases_to_test: How the site responds to different user agents (e.g., mobile vs. desktop).
Page load performance under simulated high-latency network conditions.
Handling of URL variations (e.g., with/without 'www', 'http' vs 'https').
data_requirements: No specific user data is required for this test.
prerequisites: The test environment must have an active internet connection.
DNS for 'atid.store' must be correctly resolved.
The web server hosting the site must be running.
